NavierStokes.PeriodicPaper.periodic_corollary (PeriodicPaperTheorem.lean:155) is a single unconditional declaration carrying every clause of Corollary 10.6: all ν > 0, a globally smooth time-compact ℤ³-periodic force, smoothness on Ico 0 1, the ν-residual equation, zero datum, divergence freedom, SpeedUnboundedAtOne, one compact K inside the open unit cube bounding velocity and pressure supports at all t < 1, and no global smooth periodic competitor. Its proof route (theorem_1_1_with_initial_rest, the clock λ²(t − t₀) with t₀ = 1 − λ⁻², lattice periodization, Gronwall) is the paper's proof. The only gaps between the two statements are the torus-as-periodic-lift encoding and the fact that uniqueness lives in a neighbouring theorem.

findings.summary: The torus is encoded as ℤ³-periodic lifts on ℝ³, so 'support in a fixed compact K ⊂ int Q₀' becomes tsupport(u(t,·)) ∩ fundamentalCube ⊆ K and the L∞ blowup becomes a pointwise ∃x bound.
The definite article in 'the solution (U, P_per)' — uniqueness of the smooth periodic solution for that force and datum — is not a clause of periodic_corollary; it is a separate theorem.
